relations.subject: Joseph Toussaint Reinaud
relations.evidence: He came to Paris in 1815, and became a pupil of Silvestre de Sacy.

relations.subject: Joseph Toussaint Reinaud
relations.evidence: In 1824 he entered the department of oriental manuscripts in the Royal Library at Paris

relations.subject: Joseph Toussaint Reinaud
relations.evidence: in 1838, on the death of De Sacy, he succeeded to his chair in the School of Living Oriental Languages.
